mean_only_selector_counterexample.operator: Synthetic2D W1=W2=identity, zero biases, unit gate, scalar tanh-GELU; no native QDQ/BF16 equivalence claimed.
mean_only_selector_counterexample.finding: Equal tile means can hide opposite useful nonlinear directions. A mean-only signal has no universal sufficient-information guarantee; this is not a Wan empirical failure.

dense_anchor_delta_budget.assumption: One full dense initial cache per expert, followed by sparse hidden updates at fractions rho1/rho3; equalM and widths.
dense_anchor_delta_budget.finding: Any positive sparse update after both dense cold starts exceeds50% mainMAC. This reconfirms docs/55; partial anchors or a different representation lie outside the assumption.

two_GEMM_GELU_proxy_budget.assumption: One approximate W1 selector retains input fraction k; exact selected W1/W2 use hidden fraction rho. Equal unit MAC costs; quantized kernel speed factors must be measured separately.
two_GEMM_GELU_proxy_budget.finding: A retained50% main path leaves nonzero selector work. Prox SwiGLU three-projection/INT4 GEMV cost constants cannot be copied into this two-GEMM, fullM HiF4 baseline.

scope: Mathematical counterexample and source-aligned cost accounting. No rejection of every mean-based empirical router, sparse-delta algorithm or proxy family, and no new model eligibility.

preliminary_execution.change: Added the explicit synthetic operator assumptions; numerical inputs/results unchanged.
